# The AO Audit — Answer Optimization
AO = Answer Optimization — the practice the industry also calls AEO (answer engine optimization) and GEO (generative engine optimization).
Pricing: free scan · $39 playbook · $497 The Answer (done-for-you) · $249/mo AO Care — https://aoaudit.com/pricing.html
Versión en español / Spanish pages: landing https://aoaudit.com/es.html · precios (pricing) https://aoaudit.com/precios.html · qué es el SEO para IA (the AO/AEO/GEO explainer) https://aoaudit.com/seo-para-ia.html · por qué existimos (why we exist) https://aoaudit.com/por-que-existimos.html

> The AO Audit is a free interactive Answer Optimization (AO) audit that scores
> how visible a business is to AI engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google
> AI Mode) and AI agents. Twenty-two checks across four pillars — Entity, Content,
> Code, Agents — returning a 0-100 AO Score and a prioritized fix list.
> Companion tool to the paid guide "Be the Answer: The AI-Search Authority
> Playbook." Updated July 2026.

## Core content

- [The AO Audit](https://aoaudit.com/): run the audit and get your AO Score
  with a scored, prioritized fix list.
- [Sample AO Report](https://aoaudit.com/sample-report.pdf): a real example of
  the full report, no email required.

## Key facts

- Answer Optimization (AO) is the practice of making a business the answer AI
  engines give: findable, understandable, trustworthy, and transactable to
  machines.
- The AO Score measures how easily Google and AI tools can read and verify a
  business's website, and whether it shows the basics AI agents need to book
  or buy. It does not predict or promise what any AI will recommend.
- Clean structured data (schema.org) makes a business's name, address, hours
  and services easy for machines to read and check.
- Businesses that are hard for machines to read are not penalized by AI
  engines, but they are harder for those engines to find, verify, and quote.
